note: Subset of golden_baskets.json: the five main-course baskets added 2026-08-18. Run with scripts/eval-mains.sh. Edit golden_baskets.json, not this file, and re-derive if the baskets change.

baskets.intent: Single item: must STAY produce-led. Ryan's own pear/pork example, which the basket-size rule deliberately overrules

expect.main_course_note: One item, so no counter buy and no protein cooked in. The protein field should carry a pairing instead.

baskets.intent: Three items that cannot be a meal on their own: should build a main with a protein cooked in (the squid case)

expect.main_course_note: Expect a counter register in ingredients, the protein worked into the method, protein field null, and the produce leading the title.

baskets.intent: Two items, the slow end: fruit plus allium, the meat counter is fair game (basket kept clear of the prompt's worked examples)

expect.main_course_note: Two items is permission, not obligation. Basket deliberately does NOT match any worked example in worker/prompt.js: the first version used pear + red onion, which is Example 5's exact basket, so the engine could pass by copying rather than reasoning. Keep golden baskets disjoint from the prompt's examples.

baskets.intent: Vegan main course: the likeliest regression. Must be a real main, not a vegetable dish with chickpeas beside it

expect.main_course_note: No animal protein anywhere. Judge on heft and technique: a braise on a proper soffritto, hard-roasted pulses, a whole vegetable roasted to collapsing.

baskets.intent: Ten items in high summer: a main is now permitted, but it must not become a mess

expect.main_course_note: Peak produce, so restraint is still a legitimate answer. This basket exists to catch the opposite failure: a protein bolted onto ten vegetables. HARNESS/APP DISAGREEMENT: the app's seasonalityOf() calls fennel OUT in August, so the engine is told it is off-season and should flag it; grade.py's text parser calls it IN and will therefore fire a false 'note present but all items look in-season' warning. Pre-existing, and it hits edge-big-basket too. See the seasonality caveat in RUBRIC.md: trust the app.
